description: This file contains definitions and implementations for the ISC Class Browser module of the SmartClient framework, including class definitions, UI component setup, and data source configurations.

classes.name: JavaClassPane
classes.description: A layout component that displays Java source code in a source view, with methods to load and display source code.

classes.name: JVMClassTree
classes.description: A TreeGrid component representing the Java class hierarchy, backed by JVMClassTreeDS data source.

classes.name: ClassBrowser
classes.description: Main component that integrates class tree, source view, and UI controls for browsing Java classes.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the ClassBrowser widget, setting up the class tree, layout, and event handlers.

methods.name: classChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a class is selected in the class tree, displaying its details.

methods.name: showClassPane
methods.description: Displays the pane with class details for a selected class.

methods.name: escapeForId
methods.description: Sanitizes class path strings to be used as HTML element IDs.

methods.name: showPane
methods.description: Displays a specific pane in the right section of the layout, creating it if necessary.
